calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Sep-25-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Maureen Howard.
Petitioner: Guoxin Chen, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Hua Ying Chen, and with Cantonese Interpreter: Jenna Zhang.
Petitioner and Interpreter were sworn and examined.
No appearance by Co-Petitioner/Minor's Mother: Shuzhen Chen, but signed the Petition consent to the name change of the Minor.
No objections to the proposed change of name of the Minor were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Minor to: Joyce Huaying Chen.
Decree signed in open court.
